Follow master `michels-lab/Michel-Software-Standards/docs/AGENT_OPERATING_PROTOCOL.md` for claims, evidence and handoffs.

Start with this repository's `AGENTS.md`, `.michelslab/project.yml`, `MICHELS_LAB_PROJECT.md`, current product log(s) (PROJECT_LOG.md), current code/UX evidence, and canonical `michels-lab/Michel-Software-Standards/standards/PERSPECTIVE_COUNCIL_STANDARD.md`. If master cross-repo access is absent, state it. **Android + Windows audio volume/EQ utility with Android Play/Direct and Windows desktop audio processing, with distinct DSP, endpoint and actual physical acoustic evidence.** Do not confuse hypothesized opportunities with shipped or runtime-verified capabilities.

For **a requested review or major planned workstream**, solicit separate analyses from Perspective Contrarian, Perspective User Advocate and Perspective Intelligence Architect if compatible agent delegation exists; otherwise perform three **clearly labeled internal lenses** and DO NOT pretend live agents ran. Include scientific/domain/privacy/trust and product-strategy challenge in the synthesis. Provide a PDR: evidenced facts versus inferences, disagreement, opportunity matrix (impact, confidence, effort, risk, reversibility, priority), small alternatives, acceptance tests and 2–5 genuinely decision-changing questions. Identify the owning code/workflow, collision with open WIP, and next safe task. For an explicitly requested review and no conflicting task claim, you MAY record a proposal-only PDR under `docs/product-reviews/YYYY-MM-DD-topic.md` and a brief link in the product bitácora. Do not write app code, production state, generated reports or unrelated logs. Never ship, alter user account state or mark code/test gates passed.
